desc.zh: 先读光，再关灯：用四组计数维护稀疏网格。
desc.en: Read the light before switching lamps off: maintain four sparse line counts.

complexity: O(L + Q) expected time; O(U) auxiliary space plus O(Q) output, U distinct lamps

concepts.name: Sparse line counts
concepts.description: Maintain exact row, column and diagonal counts for active lamps.

concepts.name: Read before mutation
concepts.description: Answer each query before removing adjacent lamps.
